title: TTL budget check on custody accept
description: Before accepting custody, estimate whether the message can reach its destination before expiry. Calculate remaining_s = msg.expiry - now(), est_delay_s = hops_to_dest * avg_hop_latency (default 10s/hop). Reject with 5.03 reason=ttl_insufficient if remaining < estimated delay. Requires GNSS wall-clock time (always available). Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1 TTL Budget Check. All three impls. Depends on: custody resource handler (ldhl.5).
